# Mitiquete SecureFlow Web pilot preparation

This directory contains a content-bound, blocked-by-default pilot plan for the
apex host `mitiqueteonline.com`. It records the user's owner authorization
assertion and the planned read-only limits. It does not contain production
responses, credentials, personal data, or evidence that any network request
was executed.

The plan remains blocked until ownership evidence is independently bound, the
bounded production transport exists, and staging has completed. Authentication,
role, and tenant comparisons remain disabled and require dedicated test
accounts if enabled later.
